errors.what: First patch-data rejected: change needs attribution (--agent/--action required)
errors.recovered_by: Re-ran patch-data with --agent pricing-update and a descriptive --action string

problems_and_friction: patch-data requires attribution flags that the protocol step did not mention, so the first invocation failed and had to be re-run. The CLI repeatedly nudges to run pack-html to refresh the 'stale' human view, but the protocol forbids it because both fields are data-bound {{}} and resolve from window.__CLAN__.data at runtime.
context_understood: Both zoho_price_per_seat and zoho_annual_total are data-bound fields, so a single patch-data updates both the data layer and the rendered view without re-authoring any HTML.
